note: The repeated diagnostic command is preserved from model-calls line 14; target/session identifiers are replaced in tests. Never execute this fixture.
command:
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
TMPD=$(mktemp -d)
echo '== cpu =='
grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo
nproc
echo '== mem =='
awk '/MemTotal/ {printf "MemTotalKB=%s\n", $2}' /proc/meminfo
free -m
echo '== swap =='
swapon --show > "$TMPD/swap.out" 2>&1; rc=$?
echo "swapon_exit=$rc"
if [ -s "$TMPD/swap.out" ]; then cat "$TMPD/swap.out"; else echo SWAP_NONE_ACTIVE; fi
echo '== conntrack =='
if command -v conntrack >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo CONNTRACK_PRESENT; command -v conntrack; conntrack --version > "$TMPD/conntrack.out" 2>&1 || echo "conntrack_version_exit=$?"; head -n 1 "$TMPD/conntrack.out" 2>/dev/null || true; else echo CONNTRACK_MISSING; fi
echo '== package manager =='
if command -v rpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo RPM_PRESENT; else echo RPM_ABSENT; fi
if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo DNF_PRESENT; dnf --version > "$TMPD/dnf.out" 2>&1; echo "dnf_version_exit=$?"; head -n 1 "$TMPD/dnf.out"; else echo DNF_ABSENT; fi
echo '== conntrack package availability =='
if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then dnf list --available conntrack-tools > "$TMPD/dnflist.out" 2>&1; rc=$?; echo "dnf_list_exit=$rc"; tail -n 5 "$TMPD/dnflist.out"; else echo DNF_ABSENT; fi
echo '== existing kubeadm state =='
if [ -s /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf ]; then echo ADMIN_CONF_PRESENT; else echo ADMIN_CONF_ABSENT; fi
if [ -s /etc/kubernetes/kubeadm-init.log ]; then echo INIT_LOG_PRESENT; else echo INIT_LOG_ABSENT; fi
echo '== taints/static pods =='
if [ -d /etc/kubernetes/manifests ]; then ls -1 /etc/kubernetes/manifests; else echo MANIFESTS_DIR_ABSENT; fi
rm -rf "$TMPD"
